name: Nero
contribution: Roman emperor from AD 54 until his suicide in AD 68.

checks.lead: Nero Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (born Lucius Domitius Ahenobarbus, later Nero Claudius Caesar Drusus Germanicus; 15 December AD 37 – 9 June AD 68) was Roman emperor from AD 54 until his suicide in AD 68. He was the final emperor of the Julio-Claudian dynasty, which comprised the first five emperors.
